stem_book: [Choose one or more than one correct options] Let θ, φ ∈ [0, 2π] be such that 2cosθ(1 − sinφ) = sin²θ(tan(θ/2) + cot(θ/2))cosφ − 1, tan(2π − θ) > 0, and −1 < sinθ < −√3/2. Then φ cannot satisfy [JEE Advanced 2012] (a) 0 < φ < π/2 (b) π/2 < φ < 4π/3 (c) 4π/3 < φ < 3π/2 (d) 3π/2 < φ < 2π
work: sin²θ(tan(θ/2)+cot(θ/2)) = 2sinθ ⇒ sin(θ+φ) = cosθ + 1/2 ∈ (1/2, 1) for θ ∈ (3π/2, 5π/3) ⇒ θ+φ ∈ (13π/6, 17π/6) ⇒ φ ∈ (π/2, 4π/3) only ⇒ cannot: a, c, d
